literal.description: A string, a whole number, true, false, null, or a list of those.

description: How `.journal/plugins/code-commandments/bin/commandments-release judge` reads this project. Every key is optional; `.journal/plugins/code-commandments/bin/commandments-release config` shows what runs.

$schema.description: The schema this file is checked against, written by `.journal/plugins/code-commandments/bin/commandments-release sync`.

agents.description: Agents a config from the PHP tool turned on by name. Every project runs both agents the tool ships and it ships no other, so each name here is skipped, and said so.

base.description: The branch `--branch` compares against when it names none: this project's trunk. Left out, it is main. A branch named on the command line always wins.

configure.description: Detectors tuned, keyed by engine/Name for a shipped rule or by name for one of the project's own. Each step calls one of the detector's methods with its arguments in order, as {"layer": ["App\\Http", ["App\\Domain"]]}. One step is the config's own rather than the detector's: {"judges": ["tests"]} lets this one rule judge a folder the project excludes, which stays excluded for every other rule.

anyOf.description: A rule of the project's own, by name.

detectors.description: The project's own detectors in .commandments/custom/, by name, turned on.

disable.description: Rules and languages turned off. A detector is off when it, its sin or its skill is named here.

agents.description: Agents turned off, by name: ClaudeAgent or CodexAgent.

detectors.description: Detectors turned off, shipped (engine/Name) or the project's own (Name).

anyOf.description: A rule of the project's own, by name.

languages.description: Languages the project does not write; judge never reads them.

sins.description: Sins turned off, whichever detector finds them.
